title: Joyce:
title_q: She Didn't Have to Sell the Cow
title_short: Vishal · Joyce: She Didn't Have to Sell the Cow
headline: Joyce's problem was timing, not income. For her first daughter's school fees she sold a cow. For the second, she took a Kiva loan and kept it.
story: Vishal learns the most when he meets borrowers in person.
In Nairobi school fees are paid in one lump sum. For her first daughter, Joyce sold her cow.
For her second daughter she took a Kiva loan, paid the fees and kept the cow.
do: Cold open on the cow line with hook text, then jump back to the start.
Keep the story in order: opener, Nairobi setup, daughter 1, daughter 2.
Name super after the hook: “Vishal Ghotge” / “CEO of Kiva”, small, lower corner.
Cover every trim with Block 3 BROLL.
End card: “Give a little. Change a lot.” + kiva.org.
End on the cow line at 01:05.
dont: Not about Kiva the institution or microfinance in general.
No name super for Joyce: she is not on camera.
Use 01:19 only if the cut needs a closing thought.
No name plate, logo or fade at 0:00.
Never the transcript's spelling of his name.
No big lime captions. Brit's caption spec only.
